partial_artifact_behavior: Partial results stay in V6/data/model_runs/v6_24_p5_work/checkpoints/ and are NEVER promoted to processed/. Shiny must not see them.
completion_required_for_success: ALL 1,350 model-series runs must complete, or the owner must approve a documented exception. No silent missing model rows.
notes: Reference calibration: the HDD run completed 4,915 series-origins x 15 models = 73,725 fits within a 4-hour budget with a 38-minute reserve. P5 needs 12,000 fits, about 16% of that, so roughly 20-40 minutes is expected. The 2-hour budget carries a wide margin.
